principle: Existing projects remain independently testable. CivicOS composes them through explicit capability contracts instead of merging them into a monolith.

GitLaw.role: source-grounded German federal-law retrieval and citation verification
limitations: broader legal-answer evaluation with qualified professionals still needed

PruefPilot.role: typed document intake, extraction, evidence checks and versioned domain rules
limitations: production identity/access, persistence, retention/deletion and security review still needed

SafeVoice.role: digital-harassment evidence intake, hashing, classification and reviewable case packaging
limitations: curated evaluations are not validated police cases
broader real-user and qualified-reviewer validation needed

PublicMoneyMCP.role: deterministic German federal-budget and Bundesrechnungshof tools
limitations: mainly Einzelplan-level
upstream data not continuously synchronised
BRH coverage curated rather than exhaustive
anomaly flags are leads, not misconduct findings

CitizenAgents.role: monitored public-source changes with cited findings, logs and human review
limitations: agent/integration maturity varies; repository logs are source of truth

DigitalWorkerFactory.role: bounded agent runtime, capabilities, evidence requirements, policy gates, human approval and audit
limitations: synthetic evals prove regression discipline, not real-world accuracy

JudgeMCP.role: composable rubric evaluation and bounded create-judge-revise loops
limitations: LLM scores are calibrated rather than objective truth
rubric quality limits evaluator quality

WohngeldMCP.role: Wohngeld pre-check, approximate calculator, Mietstufe and local-office lookup
limitations: calculator is approximate
rule/constants freshness must be updated after reforms
no application submission

ElterngeldMCP.role: deterministic Elterngeld calculation, eligibility cap, plan comparison and office lookup
limitations: 2024/2025 constants require freshness gate
Mutterschaftsgeld offset not modeled
self-employment cases approximate

CivicMCPToolkit.role: shared MCP server factory, tracing, structured logging, health checks, error envelopes and fixtures
limitations: existing MCPs are not all migrated to the toolkit yet

OpenAction.role: shared case truth, constraints, ownership, evidence-linked actions, approval paths, trust passports and change impact
limitations: external authority/domain review and real event exports still required
not an official standard

SafeTraceEntityResolution.role: explainable organisation identity matching and ambiguity review
limitations: synthetic benchmark
needs live register adapters and larger diverse evaluation corpus

SafeTrace.role: claim/evidence graph, provenance, contradictions and investigative review
limitations: several investigative data connectors still source-snapshot rather than live

CityKnowledgeGraph.role: municipal services, authorities, responsibilities and governing-rule relationships
limitations: coverage is a proof graph, not a complete German administrative ontology

CasePilot.role: agent/workflow reliability checks for completion, required tools, evidence, loops and escalation
limitations: current proof is synthetic rather than production telemetry
